conflicts.versions: Lesson 3 mini-problem uses five days of sales: 40, 45, 42, 50 and 45, giving a mean of 44.4 and a mode of 45, so the fifth day is 45. Lessons 5 and 7 and the fact sheet give Mon 40, Tue 45, Wed 42, Thu 50, Fri 65 (then Sat 30, Sun 20), so Friday is 65, the highest day. The same five days carry different values for the fifth.
